items.summary: Fix the background music experience so the romantic instrumental is reliably audible for users: the play/pause control must successfully start playback after a user click, the volume control must affect the actual playing volume, and the UI must clearly indicate when autoplay is blocked and how to start music.

Update the NO-click prompt sequence shown after each NO selection to match the user-provided escalation list, but render all prompts in English and display them as the flashing/pulsing message (not as the NO button label).
Continue to visually increase the YES button size on each NO click, but do not remove, hide, disable, or otherwise prevent selecting NO; the user must always be able to select NO.
